Sofia: quick sync — final speaker briefing for Fri webinar. need confirmations on who speaks, who monitors chat, and how leads are routed. link: https://docs.google.com/example :spiral_calendar:
Raj: I'll open with the benchmark headline (60s) and the product narrative (4m).
Mei: I'll handle chat moderation and capture questions for panel. put me in the routing loop.
Tom: I can do the demo. plan: 8m live + 30s transition to panel. will use cache-friendly prompts.
Alex: ops note: prerec clip stored as demo_short_v1.mp4 in GDrive. I'll have local copy and alt link.
Casey: Ops will run the routing form. enterprise leads -> #sales-leads, trial interest -> #growth, general -> #support.
Sofia: rehearsal times: Thu 10:30 (tech run), Fri 09:00 (final). please upload slides + speaker notes by Wed EOD.
Tom: demo prompts (short): "Summarize this policy in 3 bullets." "Show a 2-turn user session, <=120 tokens."
Mei: QA flow: if chat asks pricing, reply with link to intake form; if technical, ping Raj; if infra, ping Casey.
Alex: fallback plan: if latency spike >500ms p95, switch to prerec clip and announce on stream. Casey will execute failover command.
Casey: failover command (ops): deploybot trigger --clip demo_short_v1.mp4 --announce "Switching to prerecorded demo"
Sofia: great — locking speaker order and sending invites. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
